thread:
morgan: Heads-up: RC cutoff at 15:00 PT. Can we do a quick CI green sweep on main + release/1.8.0? Post results here. I'll coordinate branch freeze.

emily: On it. Kicking off full test matrix on main, e2e after unit pass.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Build #4823 queued: main — full-matrix

raj: Noted — I'll watch flaky test queue. If integration-db fails again I'll bisect.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Build #4823 failed: integration-db::TestUserCreation — flake suspected. Logs: http://ci/4823/logs

raj: I'm repro'ing locally, looks like test DB race with migrations. Temporary unskip? I'll post a patch.

emily: If you need, I can revert the last flaky-pr (PR #2135) from main to get green for cutoff.

laura: Quick changelog reminder: bump version to 1.8.0-rc before tagging. Who's handling the changelog aggregation?

dan: I'll assemble changelog. Please add short bullets in this thread with PR# and one-liner.

emily: PR #2140 — fix: tokenization edge case impacting embeddings. @dan one-liner: 'fix: tokenization regression in embed pipeline'

raj: PR #2136 — ci: fix flaky integration-db tests by adding retry on setup. One-liner: 'ci: add retry to integration-db setup to mitigate race'

morgan: If we can't get main green by 14:15 PT, plan B: branch release/1.8.0 from commit abcdef2 (last known green) — @emily can you branch and push?

emily: Yes, I'll cherry-pick and branch. Command I'll run:
```
git checkout -b release/1.8.0 abcdef2
git cherry-pick 2140 2136
git push origin release/1.8.0
```

ci-bot: ci-bot: Started: Build #4824 queued: release/1.8.0 — smoke + sanity

emily: Smoke passed, sanity failing on lint only in new test file. Pushing quick lint fix.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Build #4824 passed: release/1.8.0

laura: Version bump done on branch, tag ready. @morgan do you want me to create the release candidate tag and upload release notes draft?

morgan: Yes please. Tag as v1.8.0-rc.1. @dan I'll need the aggregated bullets by 14:30 so I can finalize notes.

dan: Got it — assembling now, will paste below in 10m.

dan: Changelog bullets:
- PR #2140: fix: tokenization regression in embed pipeline
- PR #2136: ci: add retry to integration-db setup
- PR #2128: feat: expose cache stats in /metrics
- PR #2110: perf: improve KV cache hit rate for short prefixes

morgan: :thumbsup: All good. Final check: any DB migration in this release? @raj

raj: No schema changes, only migration-related timing tweaks in tests. Safe to deploy.

morgan: OK locking cutoff in 10m. If anything else, post here. Thanks!
